_comment: Every daily anchor this project has written on chain, newest last. An entry is added only after the transaction is confirmed on chain — this file records facts, never intentions. `npm run verify:anchors` recomputes each day's chain head from the code and fails if any hash here disagrees, and `tests/anchors.test.ts` does the same in CI. Memo format: ffw:1|<season>|<YYYY-MM-DD>|<lastTick>|<chainHash>
